name: 家用多用途本色烘焙油纸卷款
description: 铺烤盘、垫托盘、折纸包入炉，一纸串起快手晚餐与甜点台

styleLock.direction: warm realistic kitchen-consumable commerce with a clean studio packshot front end
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white studio sweep for packshots, one saturated cobalt gradient field for the spec screen, and real stone or walnut work surfaces for every use scene; backgrounds alternate shot to shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft key with bounce fill on the packshots, warm directional daylight around 4800-5400K in the scenes, single light direction per frame, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: cool light marble #F2EFEA for the baking scenes, dark walnut #4A2E1E with indigo linen for the serving and packet scenes, white marble #F4F1EC for the closing flat lay
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; in-image copy limited to one short headline per screen, set in a translucent accent banner band at the bottom edge
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in the accent hue only, no filled or 3D icons
styleLock.presentationRules: carton kept at identical scale and proportion wherever it appears; laid sheet always the same kraft tan tone #C6A16B; food never obscures the whole sheet; hands only as generic cropped supporting elements
noDrift: no invented numeric specifications rendered in-image
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm realistic kitchen-consumable visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cobalt banner blue #1E4FA8, kraft tan #C6A16B and walnut brown #4A2E1E; backgrounds alternate between a seamless white studio sweep, one saturated cobalt gradient spec field and real marble or walnut work surfaces; bright soft studio key with bounce fill for packshots and warm directional daylight around 4800-5400K for scenes, single light direction per frame, gentle contact shadows, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with one short headline in a translucent bottom banner band; thin single-weight line icons in the accent hue only; stable carton scale and identical sheet tone across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented numeric specifications rendered in-image.

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清盒型与品类，用干净横放盒身拿下首图点击。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, long narrow carton lying horizontally with the front panel square to camera and a sliver of the top face above it
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front softbox key with bounce card on the shadow side, soft single contact shadow
shots.whitespace: generous clean space above and below the horizontal carton, no side whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The long narrow carton lies horizontally on a studio sweep, straight-on eye-level view with the front panel square to camera and a sliver of the top face reading above it; the whole carton stays inside the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a front softbox with a bounce card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding the carton, no harsh speculars. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, with generous empty space above and below the horizontal carton and no extra whitespace beside it. Square 1:1 commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no food, no hands, no watermark, no badge or star-rating graphics, no promo corner flags, no cut-off carton ends, no warped carton edges, no duplicated top panel, no two conflicting shadow directions.

shots.intent: 用一条空白标尺位回应「一卷能铺多宽」，数值留白待后期合成。
shots.camera: clean 90-degree side profile elevation, carton low in the frame
shots.lighting: even front studio light with a soft radial falloff behind the carton, faint contact shadow only
shots.background: saturated cobalt blue gradient #1E4FA8 deepening to #0B2A66 toward the corners
shots.props: one thin white double-headed arrow above the carton with an empty rounded label badge at its centre
shots.whitespace: entire upper half kept as clean blue negative space for the single callout
shots.textZone: 产品上方居中空白标尺位，预留「{callout_1}」后期合成
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce specification screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The carton shown as a clean 90-degree side profile low in the frame, with a thin white double-headed arrow spanning its full width directly above and one blank rounded label badge centred on that arrow, kept empty as a placeholder reserved for the spec callout 「{callout_1}」 to be composited after generation. Even front studio light with a soft radial falloff behind the carton and only a faint contact shadow beneath it. Background a saturated cobalt blue gradient #1E4FA8 deepening to #0B2A66 toward the corners. The product occupies 35-40% of the frame, leaving the entire upper half as clean negative space for the single callout. Square 1:1. Negative: no digits or unit symbols rendered in-image, no dense body text, no secondary arrows or extra graphics, no watermark, no badge or star-rating graphics, no cropped carton ends, no floor reflection artifacts, no colour cast shifting the carton tone.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 纯白底横放长盒主图，可见正面与顶面，盒面贴有烤制菜品图与规格字行；002 钴蓝渐变底侧面平视盒身，上方一条双箭头横向标注；003 正上方俯拍金属烤盘内铺纸，承托芝士烤制主食，大理石台面、木托与两只小碗；004 正上方俯拍胡桃木铜柄托盘内铺纸，摆成分享拼盘；005 高 45 度俯拍金属烤盘上三只折纸包（两只开口盛鱼排、柠檬、芦笋、洋葱），蓝布垫与酒杯；006 正上方俯拍大理石台面上铺开的大张纸面，晾置巧克力蘸点心，一只手把点心浸入碗中巧克力。品类判定依据：无电加热、无电机的小件厨房耗材，使用动作全部发生在烤盘/托盘/炉内，故取「家居日用 / 厨房用品」，未按源站家庭清洁类挂载。已剥离：原品牌字标与盒面英文字行、原图英文标语原句、盒面尺寸数字与材质比例及耐温类声明、底部色带原句（改为 {selling_point_1..4} 占位）、双箭头标注数值（改为空白标尺位 {callout_1}）、任何徽章与口碑角标；产品一律以 {product} 占位，材质特写镜为原图可见纸面纹理的拆解补足。
